# by         Essenthos: each word read against its verse in BHSA, the Samaritan Pentateuch, the Septuagint (GRCBRENT), the Vulgate (VULGCLEM), the Ge'ez, NESTLE1904 and TR1894 by claude-opus-5-5 on 2026-11-16, on the project owner's rule of 2026-11-16 that the word the original writes decides

# One row per settled word, applied by forge owner-rows; 'why' is the reading the row rests on. A creature is named where a text writes its word; a witness word is named where it renders that word as a creature (blight, rot, wax or stones are not named); a word said of a person by a figure is not named.
